page.title: Nkitahodi ahorow
page.intro: Fa wo dawurubɔ akontaabu ahorow no bata ho. Leads a efi wo dawurubɔ ahorow mu no ba My Leads no mu ara kwa, a sika a wɔsɛe no ne ɛka a wɔbɔ wɔ lead biara ho.

catalog.linkedinDescription: Lead Gen Form di anim kɔ My Leads, da biara da sika a wɔsɛe no ne ɛka a wɔbɔ wɔ lead biara mu, ne lead quality a wɔde san kɔ LinkedIn ( Conversions API ).

catalog.notAvailable: Wɔnnyɛ nhyehyɛe wɔ saa server yi so de besi nnɛ

banner.connected: LinkedIn a ɛwɔ nkitahodi. Wɔrefa leads mprempren - krataafa yi updates wɔ bere tiaa bi mu.
banner.notConfigured: LinkedIn nnya nsiesiee wɔ saa server yi so. Ɛsɛ sɛ ɔhwɛfoɔ bi de LinkedIn app no ​​client ID ne ahintasɛm ka ho.
banner.expired: LinkedIn nkitahodi no atwam, enti leads no nnyɛ syncing. San fa wo ho hyɛ mu na woatoa so.
banner.reconnectSoon: LinkedIn hwehwɛ sɛ wosan kɔ mu bio ansa na {{date}} adu. San fa bata ho ansa na saa bere no adu na ama nhama no akɔ so asen.

connect.title: Fa LinkedIn no di nkitaho
connect.intro: Fa LinkedIn akontaabu a ɛhwɛ wo dawurubɔ ahorow so no kɔ mu. Leadrat kenkan wo dawurubɔ akontaabu, Lead Gen Form akannifo ne dawurubɔ akontaabu nkutoo, na ɛde nsakrae a woadan no kɔ.
connect.need1: Dwumadi bi wɔ LinkedIn dawurubɔ akontaabu (Viewer anaa nea ɛboro saa).
connect.need2: Dwumadi bi wɔ adwumakuw krataafa a ɛwɔ nkitahodi no so (Administrator, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Curator anaa Analyst) - LinkedIn hwehwɛ sɛ ɛkyɛ akannifo.
connect.need3: Telefon nɔma ho asɛmmisa wɔ wo Lead Gen Forms - leads a enni telefon nɔma no ntumi nka ho.
connect.reconnect: San fa LinkedIn no bata ho

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Ka kyerɛ LinkedIn sɛ nea edi kan no mu nea ɛbɛyɛɛ anidaso ankasa. Sɛ LinkedIn kannifoɔ du gyinabea bi a wopaw wɔ aseɛ ha a, Leadrat bɔ amanneɛ kyerɛ LinkedIn , enti wo ɔsatuo amanneɛbɔ kyerɛ akannifoɔ su na LinkedIn bɛtumi anya nnipa pii te sɛ wo akannifoɔ a wɔyɛ papa paa. LinkedIn lead ID ne email no hash a ɛkɔ ɔkwan baako so nkutoo na wɔde mena.
capi.noRules: Gyinabea biara nni hɔ a wɔayɛ ho mfonini de besi nnɛ.
capi.created: Nsakyeraeɛ a wɔayɛ wɔ LinkedIn na wɔayɛ no map.
